support: Partner preview: best-effort support, no production commitment. Frozen fields in the pinned component files are the contract; a breaking change to a documented surface opens a new Distribution line, announced in advance.

surfaces.contracts: additive — rollover 0.1.0-rc.2 joins with its paired Arbitrum/Base singleton stack and BaseFiller. The phoenix 1.3.0-rc.1, market-registry 0.3.3 and cork-periphery 0.1.3-rc.1 pins are unchanged. Existing indexed contract addresses and ABIs do not move, so the indexer has nothing to re-point.
surfaces.cli-mcp: breaking — 0.2.0-rc.2 -> 0.4.1; the covered input and JSON provenance mode `centralized` became `hybrid`, rollover artifacts use the pinned rc.2 `jitMarketHash` wire, and the legacy percent-number `premium` input is refused. The full record is in the pinned CHANGELOG.
surfaces.apis: breaking since the previous Distribution pin — cork-api 0.3.6 -> 0.4.0 includes the noticed 2026-08-17 legacy `premium` removal first pinned at 0.3.16. The promoted 0.4.0 interface is byte-identical to 0.3.16 and changes only the version stamp; no database migration, route or schema changes accompany the promotion. The covered v1 route families remain served, while the rollover API family remains outside cork-api's covered route list.
surfaces.manifests: unchanged — schemaVersion 1 field names and semantics are unchanged; this cut adds four component-version rows and one Distribution row.

integrationSuite.decision: No reusable two-chain cross-component integration runner existed for either previous cut. The Distribution owner authorized an explicit exception for phoenix/v0.3-rc.1 on 2026-08-21 in COR-172, overriding v0.2-rc.1's statement that its waiver was final. No passing suite or end-to-end rollover run is claimed. A separate runner is being developed after this cut PR and this waiver must not be copied silently into another cut.
integrationSuite.nearestEvidence: cork-cli v0.4.1 shipped from signed commit 723573f57e8c9ef3773b5235f15951684f49252f through two byte-identical builds, release checksum and attestation gates, four-host binary/MCP/HyperSync smokes, and public GitHub Release publication. cork-api v0.4.0 pins the live version stamp at commit 89f6636ce2462959a6bb013e912aa5f9bccd8ccd with OpenAPI bytes identical to 0.3.16 after staging smoke and production promotion. rollover 0.1.0-rc.2 pins the reviewed paired deployment vector from private source commit 5af1048eb9896582115c3615bdc5a4a9166cbbf6. Distribution verification separately checks live contract, API and indexer surfaces. None of these evidence sources is represented as a cross-component run.

externalDependencies._note: Third-party contracts the pinned set calls into. Not Cork components, but an integrator's threat model includes them, so the pin records exactly which ones this set was built against.

deterministic-deployment-factory.note: CREATE2 address identity across chains depends on this factory.

announcements: GitHub Releases on each public pinned repository are the notice channel for cuts, deprecations and removals. cork-api 0.4.0 is a version-stamp-only promotion with OpenAPI bytes identical to 0.3.16. The legacy percent `premium` field left cork-api on 2026-08-17; cork-cli 0.4.1 refuses that field locally and `premiumAnnualized` is the one CLI listing field. The covered `centralized` to `hybrid` migration is recorded in the pinned cork-cli CHANGELOG. Cork-Technology/rollover is still private; this pin records its exact deployed commit and publication remains pending.
knownIssues: Rollover 0.1.0-rc.2 is pinned from private source commit 5af1048eb9896582115c3615bdc5a4a9166cbbf6; Cork-Technology/rollover is not public yet, its API route family remains outside cork-api's covered route list, and no end-to-end rollover integration run is claimed.
Admin and operational timelocks run at a 0-second delay — a documented fact of this partner-preview deployment.
CorkMarketCreator's on-chain version() reads "0.1.0" instead of its repo version — recorded in the cork-periphery pin; the codehash identifies the build.
scopeNotes: cork-api is a hosted service with one live deployment updated in place. The 0.4.0 pin records the honest production version; its interface bytes are identical to 0.3.16 and the availability verify asserts the covered surface stays served and unbroken.

Owner exception to R5: despite covered CLI/MCP and API breaking changes that ordinarily require a new Distribution line, the Distribution owner selected the below-1.0 sequential cut phoenix/v0.3-rc.1. This does not make the covered changes non-breaking.

The tag-pinned quickstart is orientation, not v0.4.1 integration evidence: its captured output names cork-cli v0.2.0-rc.2. Its rollover appendix is not evidence for the newly pinned rollover component.
The rollover component includes the paired singleton stack and BaseFiller. EvcRolloverAdapter and per-holder CorkRolloverContract clones remain outside the pin.
SDK tarballs, OCI, apk, hosted CVM deployment and chains other than 42161 and 8453 are outside this Distribution pin.
The indexer is unchanged because this follow-up introduces no indexed contract address or ABI change.
COR-173's downstream Zyfai integration-repository pin update is outside this cut.
